title: dryopteris navarrensis
intro: Dryopteris navarrensis, commonly known as Spanish lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestive issues, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Spanish lady fern include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Additionally, it has been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues and as an antiseptic to promote wound healing.
